Engineering the Arizona Standard

Arizona House of Film is a factory-certified installer of 3M window films. In our desert climate, where surface temperatures can exceed 160°F, we choose 3M for its industry-leading thermal stability and molecular-level UV inhibitors.

Whether you are targeting massive HVAC savings or protecting high-end interiors from solar degradation, 3M provides the nanotechnology required for long-term performance in Phoenix and Scottsdale.

Technical FAQ

Q: Is 3M window film safe for dual-pane windows?

A: Yes. 3M Prestige and Scotchtint series are engineered for dual-pane applications. We verify glass type and manufacturer specifications before every installation to ensure thermal compatibility.

Q: What is the warranty on 3M window film?

A: 3M offers a limited lifetime warranty on residential installations and a 10-year commercial warranty. Arizona House of Film backs every install with our own workmanship guarantee.

Q: Does 3M film interfere with cell signals or GPS?

A: No. The 3M Prestige Series uses non-metallic multi-layer optical technology that does not interfere with GPS, cellular, or WiFi signals — unlike older metallic films.
